summary: Founder-Beta CRUD sprint tested end-to-end. Backend: 36/36 tests pass (28 existing ops/onboarding + 8 new sprint regressions covering name resolution, missing-ref tolerance, schedules-in-payload). Frontend: 10/12 flows working (Inventory, Owners, Riders, Horses, Training add flows + onboarding hides 'Recurring Schedules' (Step 2 of 9, 11% progress observed) + required-field validation + low-stock badge all PASS). CRITICAL: /incidents and /lessons throw uncaught React runtime errors on opening their QuickAddSheet — Radix <Select.Item /> rejects empty-string value props injected by horse_id 'Facility-wide' / '— TBD —' placeholder options. Both Add flows are blocked.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening 'Report incident' sheet crashes the page with 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string'. Root cause: line 29 horseOptions injects {v: "", l: "— Facility-wide (no horse) —"} which Radix Select disallows. Sheet never renders, so admin cannot file an incident.
Opening 'Schedule lesson' sheet crashes with the same Radix Select empty-string error. Root cause: line 39 horse_id opts begin with {v: "", l: "— TBD —"}. Sheet never renders.

action_items: Replace empty-string placeholder option in Incidents.jsx (line 29) — either drop the empty option entirely (use 'no selection' = no row in opts) or use a sentinel value like '__none__' and strip it in the transform before POST.
Apply the same fix in Lessons.jsx (line 39) — '— TBD —' option must not use v:"" .

Audit Training.jsx and any other QuickAddSheet caller for the same pattern — Training did NOT crash in this run because horses.length>0 produces a non-empty opts list, but the 'No horses yet — add a horse first.' branch at line 25-26 should be checked for the same empty-string trap.
Recommended QuickAddSheet hardening: in components/onboarding/FormPrimitives Select, filter or warn when an option has value === '' so future callers cannot reproduce this bug.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickAddSheet design is clean and reusable — calm aesthetic, ESC + backdrop + Cancel + required-field toast all working. The two crashes are caller bugs, not sheet bugs.

Onboarding step filter at Onboarding.jsx line 51 correctly removes 'schedules' from visibleSteps while preserving the backend payload. Stepper now reads 'Step 2 of 9' and progress percent (11%) recalculates against visible steps — exactly per spec.

Backend test_lessons_list_and_create + new tolerance tests confirm POST /api/lessons and POST /api/training accept ghost rider_id / horse_id and return rider_name/horse_name = null, matching the documented behaviour. POST /api/incidents defaults status='open' and resolves horse_name when horse_id is provided.
GET /api/onboarding/steps still returns all 10 steps (incl. 'schedules') — backend model preservation verified by test_onboarding_steps_still_has_schedules_in_backend.
Inventory.jsx correctly groups by category and surfaces low_stock badge from the backend low_stock flag (verified with quantity=5, reorder_at=10 — badge rendered, count=1).
Lessons.jsx and Training.jsx 'Add' buttons correctly disabled when no riders / no horses — verified by code path (was not disabled in this run because seed data already provides riders + horses).

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the empty-string Select.Item issue in Incidents.jsx and Lessons.jsx, retest only /incidents 'Report incident' and /lessons 'Schedule lesson' end-to-end (open sheet, fill required fields incl. horse_id 'no selection', submit, verify item appears). All other Founder-Beta CRUD surfaces are already green. Backend pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_founder_crud_sprint.py) can be rerun as-is.
rca of the issue: Radix UI Select (used by shadcn) explicitly throws when a SelectItem has value=''. Incidents.jsx:29 and Lessons.jsx:39 each prepend {v:"", l:"placeholder"} into the opts array to give a 'no selection' choice. When QuickAddSheet mounts these as <SelectItem value="" />, React throws and renders the redbox overlay instead of the sheet. Fix: use a non-empty sentinel (e.g. '__none__') in opts and have the page-level transform() coerce that sentinel back to null before POST — or simply omit the placeholder row and let an unset Select represent the 'no horse' case (the backend already accepts horse_id=null for both endpoints — verified by test_lessons_tolerates_missing_rider and test_incidents_resolves_horse_name_and_open_status).
